description: Submits a command to the JSON API of an ISC KEA server running on the target and obtains the result.

parameters.name: arguments
parameters.description: The arguments sent along with the command, if any. Use {} to send an empty arguments dict/object instead of omitting it.

parameters.name: command
parameters.description: The name of the command to send, for example status-get.

parameters.name: rv_changed
parameters.description: A list of result codes to indicate success and changed system state. Omit this for most acquisition commands. Set it to [0] for command=lease4-del and similar which return changed system state that way. Any result codes not listed in either rv_unchanged or rv_changed are interpreted as indicating an error result. rv_unchanged has precedence over rv_changed if a result code is in both lists. Default: []

parameters.name: rv_unchanged
parameters.description: A list of result codes to indicate success but unchanged system state. Set this to [0] for most acquisition commands. Use [3] for command=lease4-del and similar which have a separate code for this. Any result codes not listed in either rv_unchanged or rv_changed are interpreted as indicating an error result. rv_unchanged has precedence over rv_changed if a result code is in both lists. Default: []

parameters.name: socket
parameters.description: The full pathname of the Unix Domain Socket to connect to. The default value is suitable for kea-dhcp4-server on Debian trixie. This module directly interfaces using UDS; the HTTP wrappers are not supported. Default: "/run/kea/kea4-ctrl-socket"

examples:
vars:
  ipaddr: "192.168.123.45"
  hwaddr: "00:00:5E:00:53:00"
tasks:

  # an example for a request acquiring information
  - name: Get KEA DHCP6 status
    kea_command:
      command: status-get
      rv_unchanged: [0]
      socket: /run/kea/kea6-ctrl-socket
    register: kea6_status
  - name: Display registered status result
    ansible.builtin.debug:
      msg: KEA DHCP6 running on PID {{ kea6_status.response.arguments.pid }}

  # an example for requests modifying state
  - name: Remove existing leases for {{ ipaddr }}, if any
    kea_command:
      command: lease4-del
      arguments:
        ip-address: "{{ ipaddr }}"
      rv_changed: [0]
      rv_unchanged: [3]
  - name: Add DHCP lease for {{ ipaddr }}
    kea_command:
      command: lease4-add
      arguments:
        ip-address: "{{ ipaddr }}"
        hw-address: "{{ hwaddr }}"
      rv_changed: [0]

return_values.name: response
return_values.description: The server JSON response. Returned: when available
